title: Enclose
headline: Enclose is an open-source workbench for CAD made with agents.
description: It works with your Claude, Codex or Grok subscription. Fork it and make it yours.
summary: Enclose is an open-source Mac app for CAD made with agents. Click a part, say what should change, and Claude, Codex or Grok edits the code and rebuilds the model.
